sharedConstraints: Photorealistic premium automotive editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Correct recognizable model proportions and factory design. Entire car with all wheels and roof fully inside frame, generous 15 percent margins. No people, other cars, signs, readable text, added logos or watermark. Blank unlettered license plate. Small authentic vehicle emblems allowed. Natural perspective and realistic lighting and reflections. Single photo, not collage.
